description:
SL4.0 is certified COC (Certificate of Conformity),4000W EEC electric scooter, which we have LED headlights and flashlights, fashionable LED display design, aluminium fork, front 13 inch aluminium alloy rim, front and rear hydraulic disc brake, colorful design for customer choice. The Elf scooter is approved by the DOT, EEC, each Citycoco scooter has a COC certificate. And can drive road traffic in America Europe, 4000W aluminum wheel powerful brushless engine, comfortable large seat. 60V 50A lithium removable battery, long running power for the drive, battery box with stronger cover, more safety and longevity. 5A quick charger, 4-6 hours can be fully charged.
Note: Due to OEM manufacturing, the included user manual may feature the factory production code (Shansu CP9), which is identical in all specifications to the Soversky SL 4.0.
